#### Description
`EqualEeightingPortfolioConstructionModel` (C# and Python) allocates all cash to the stocks who have insights in universe.
- Fixes regression tests to reflect the model logic change
- Fixes imports in python algorithms to use python models when available

#### Related Issue
Closes #2023 

#### Motivation and Context
Keep reasonable logic in our example models.

#### Requires Documentation Change
No.

#### How Has This Been Tested?
Regression tests and manually verifying that the model behaves accordingly to the designed logic. For instance, when three insights arrive at difference time steps, all cash will be allocated to the symbol (S1) of that insight, then 50% of equity will be allocated to second symbol (S2) and 50% to S1 and finally 33% of equity will be allocated to the third symbol, 33% to S2 and 33% to S1.

- [x] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Non-functional change (xml comments/documentation/etc)

pr_comments:
Almost there- I think the criteria for including the insight should also be that the insight has not expired. e.g If the insight prediction ended 3 months ago its not relevant for the portfolio today.

We should record the end-time for an insight (when its created) and use it to determine who should still be in the portfolio.

Regarding expired insights, can use `Insight.CloseTimeUtc` to determine when an insight's period has officially ended. This time isn't simply the insight's generated time + the period, but instead attempts to take into account market hours and weekends.

issue_context.title: Review EqualWeightingPortfolioConstructionModel logic
issue_context.body:
#### Expected Behavior
Equal weighting portfolio construction models (C# and Python) allocate all cash to the stocks who have insights in universe.

#### Actual Behavior
Equal weighting portfolio construction models (C# and Python) allocate only the share that each symbol when a new insight from that algorithm arrives. 

#### Potential Solution
Review the logic.

#### Checklist
- [x] I have completely filled out this template
- [x] I have confirmed that this issue exists on the current `master` branch
- [x] I have confirmed that this is not a duplicate issue by searching [issues](https://github.com/QuantConnect/Lean/issues)

review_comments: @mchandschuh, insights from removed symbols are removed here, therefore `_insightCollection` doesn't contain symbols from `_removedSymbols`.
